compute_driver_executable: compute the playwright driver executable path and CLI path for the current platform
get_driver_env: get a driver environment dictionary with language name and version metadata
build_driver_executable: build a playwright driver executable tuple for win32 or posix platforms
test_driver_env: test the driver environment dictionary contains PW_LANG_NAME and PW_CLI_DISPLAY_VERSION keys
review_driver_executable: review the compute_driver_executable function to determine node binary path and CLI path
